create_commit_scheduler: create a CommitScheduler to upload a local folder to the Hugging Face Hub at regular intervals
run_commit_scheduler_trigger: run a manual commit trigger on the CommitScheduler to push changes immediately without waiting for the scheduled interval
build_commit_scheduler_context_manager: build a CommitScheduler as a context manager to ensure proper cleanup and a final commit on exit
test_commit_scheduler_push_to_hub: test the CommitScheduler push_to_hub method to upload only changed files since the last commit
review_partial_file_io: review the PartialFileIO class that reads only the first part of a file to avoid uploading data still being written
